title: JudgeStealer: Extracting LLM Judging Capabilities across Evaluation Protocols
abstract: arXiv:2608.26982v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly used across various evaluation scenarios, making their judgment capabilities valuable intellectual property. However, black-box access exposes these capabilities to model extraction attacks. Existing extraction methods do not specifically target LLM judges and provide limited support for multiple evaluation protocols under restricted query budgets. In this study, we propose JUDGESTEALER, the first query-efficient model extraction framework for replicating judging capabilities across pointwise scoring, pairwise comparison, and listwise ranking protocols. JUDGESTEALER exploits the strong cross-protocol agreement to acquire pointwise scores and transform them into pairwise and listwise supervisions without additional victim queries. translated_title: JudgeStealer：跨评估协议提取大语言模型评判能力
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）评判器越来越多地用于各种评估场景，使其评判能力成为有价值的知识产权。然而，黑盒访问将这些能力暴露于模型提取攻击之下。现有的提取方法并未专门针对LLM评判器，且在受限查询预算下对多种评估协议的支持有限。在本研究中，我们提出JUDGESTEALER，这是首个用于复制点式评分、成对比较和列表排序协议下评判能力的查询高效模型提取框架。JUDGESTEALER利用跨协议的强一致性，获取点式分数并将其转换为成对和列表式监督信号，而无需额外的受害者查询。为了捕获信息丰富的评判模式并提高查询效率，JUDGESTEALER基于语义多样性、预测不确定性动态选择点式输入。
tldr: 本文提出了首个查询高效的模型提取框架JUDGESTEALER，通过跨协议一致性转换和动态输入选择，在有限查询预算下复制LLM评判器的多种评估能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes JUDGESTEALER, the first query-efficient model extraction framework that replicates LLM judging capabilities across multiple evaluation protocols via cross-protocol consistency transformation and dynamic input selection.
